description: Attach a library rule to a project, detach it, or switch it off for this project alone. Attaching is how one workspace rule comes to hold for several projects without being retyped. `enabled: false` keeps the attachment but stands the rule down here, leaving every other project untouched. Safe to repeat: setting the state the project is already in changes nothing.

attached.description: False detaches the rule from this project. Defaults to true (attach).

enabled.description: This project's own switch on the rule, only meaningful while attached. Defaults to true for a new attachment and leaves an existing one unchanged when omitted.

guideline_id.description: Library guideline UUID from list_workspace_guidelines. Must belong to the same workspace as the project.

name: set_project_guideline

attached.description: Whether the rule is now attached to the project.

attachment_id.description: This project's attachment row id, or null when detached.

enabled.description: This project's own switch on the rule. Absent when detached.

title: Set project guideline
